name: Sequential Prophet-5/10
description: Sequential Prophet-5 and Prophet-10 (Rev4), every parameter in their MIDI Implementation's NRPN tables.

sources.title: Prophet-5 MIDI Implementation (version 1.4)
sources.notes: NRPN tables read by tools/profiles/sequential/read-nrpn-tables.mjs from Prophet-5-MIDI-Implementation-1.4.pdf, pages 8-10 (sha256 5b86f304689a958a3cdd7f2e53a7c4c12be05da6edf09fb7597a794630dd219a), https://sequential.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Prophet-5-MIDI-Implementation-1.4.pdf. authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/sequential/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/sequential/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's NRPN tables, on its number, with its printed range and name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Values go out as the manual prints the format: NRPN MSB/LSB on CC 99/98, value MSB/LSB on CC 6/38. The instrument must have its Global MIDI parameter receive set to NRPN (or All).
NRPN 55-64 (UNISON NOTE) is left out: a run the table does not name one by one
